sn35.115:1.1: santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.115:1.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:1.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu bandho cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato
sn35.115:2.2: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.115:2.3: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:2.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu bandho manoviññeyyesu dhammesu āvāsagato mārassa mārassa vasaṃ gato
sn35.115:3.1: santi ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.115:3.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu mutto cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi na āvāsagato mārassa na mārassa vasaṃ gato
sn35.115:4.2: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.115:4.3: tañce bhikkhu na abhinandati na abhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:4.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu mutto manoviññeyyehi dhammehi na āvāsagato mārassa na mārassa vasaṃ gato
